#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

bool check(int w, int n, int a[]) {
    int i = 1;
    while (true) {
        if (i > n) return true;
        if (a[i] > 1) {
            a[i] += 1;
            if (a[i] == w) {
                while (i <= n && a[i] >= w) {
                    a[i] = 0;
                    i++;
                    a[i] += 1;
                }
            } else {
                i++;
            }
            if (a[i-1] > 1) return false;
        } else {
            i++;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    int n = 0;
    int a[51] = {0}; // 1-indexed, size 51 to be safe
    do {
        a[++n] = m % w;
        m /= w;
    } while (m > 0);
    cout << (check(w, n, a) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
